telemetry.title: Execution telemetry, only from providers that expose it honestly
issues: Define the execution record, including what an absence looks like
Record telemetry a provider reports, and refuse anything it did not
Prove a silent provider produces an explicit absence, never a guess
Read the measurements back through the history surface, under a bound
Publish the telemetry claim and record what remains unmeasured

intents.t: Every managed session leaves what it observed, and the repository groups and routes it without being asked
Work starts bound to the intent it serves, and a worker resumes knowing whether that intent moved
Every change can be traced to the intent it serves, and an intent reads satisfied only when evidence says so
The plan of an intent is checked against it before execution, from a recorded gap and a recorded critique
The owner directs the repository's development from the UI, from an intent to the move that starts its next issue
